definition: Wash the coriander, dry it fully, wrap in a tissue and keep it in an airtight box in the fridge.
tip: Removing the roots before storing keeps leaves fresh for a week.

definition: Dry the curry leaves completely and keep them in an airtight container in the fridge.
tip: You can also freeze them and use straight from the freezer.

definition: Keep ripe tomatoes at room temperature, stalk side down, and use within a few days.
tip: Refrigerate only fully ripe ones to slow spoilage.

definition: Remove the stalks, dry the chillies well and store them in a tissue-lined box in the fridge.
tip: Stalks left on make them rot faster.

definition: Grind ginger and garlic with a little salt and oil, then store in a clean dry jar in the fridge.
tip: Freeze in ice cube trays for ready-to-use portions.

definition: Store ghee in a clean dry glass jar, use a dry spoon every time, and keep it away from moisture.
tip: Wet spoons are the main reason ghee spoils.

definition: Rinse the rice until the water is clearer, use the right water ratio and let it rest covered after cooking.
tip: A few drops of lemon juice keeps grains separate.

definition: Use the correct urad dal to rice ratio, grind to a smooth batter, and ferment it well before steaming.
tip: Add a little soaked poha for extra softness.

definition: Spread the batter thin on a well-heated tawa and add a little oil around the edges.
tip: A spoon of rava or fenugreek seeds in batter adds crispness.

definition: Chill the onions for 15 minutes or cut them near running water to reduce eye irritation.
tip: A sharp knife crushes fewer cells, so less gas escapes.

definition: Store cut onions in an airtight container in the fridge and use within 2 days.
tip: Keep them away from other foods to avoid smell transfer.

definition: Place a wooden spoon across the pan or use a heavy-bottomed pot and keep the flame medium.
tip: Rinse the pan with water before boiling to stop sticking.

definition: Add a peeled raw potato, a spoon of curd or a little cream to soften the saltiness.
tip: Adding a pinch of sugar can balance the taste too.

definition: Knead with warm water, rest the dough for 20 minutes and cook on a hot tawa.
tip: A spoon of oil or milk in the dough keeps rotis soft longer.

definition: Boil water with lemon slices or vinegar in the pan to neutralise burnt odour.
tip: Open windows and run the chimney while boiling.

definition: Add warm water with a drop of dish soap and run the mixer for 30 seconds, then rinse.
tip: A lemon peel run in the jar removes smell.

definition: Sprinkle baking soda or a paste of soda and water on the stain, leave 10 minutes and scrub.
tip: Warm water and dish soap work well on wall tiles.

definition: Place an open bowl of baking soda or a cut lemon inside the fridge to absorb odours.
tip: Replace every 2-3 weeks and wipe spills quickly.

definition: Put boiled eggs in cold water right after cooking, then tap and roll to crack the shell.
tip: Slightly older eggs peel more easily than very fresh ones.

definition: Store flour and rava in airtight containers and add a few dried neem leaves or bay leaves.
tip: Refrigerating fresh flour for 2 days helps kill eggs.

definition: Scrub with salt and lemon, rinse, then dry upright so it does not stay damp.
tip: Use separate boards for raw meat and vegetables.
